en: I am Agatha of the Elite Four. Oak's taken a liking to you, has he? That old fool.
Pokémon are for battling! I'll show you what a real trainer can do, child.
Oh ho! You're something special, child.
I see now why Oak thinks so highly of you. Go on, then. You're nearly at the top.
You win! Now be off with you. There's one more of us waiting.
